translation: Refined by fire for a hundred days, take one knife-blade measure (一刀圭); if taken unrefined, it kills people and the hundred beasts. One name is 石 (yùshí), one name is 大白石 (dàbáishí), one name is 澤乳 (zérǔ), one name is 食鹽 (shíyán). It grows in the mountain valleys of Hanzhong and at Shaoshi; gathered at no fixed time.
